role.altitude: The accountant stops keying, matching and ticking in Excel. They own the match rules, tie-outs and control tests that check every invoice and entry in AFAS, and spend their time on exceptions, adjusting entries and findings for the controller.
reach: Bookkeeper: AP intake and payment runs. Learn which match tolerances and approval routes cut touches without raising the error rate.
Controller: close calendar and sign-off. Learn which tie-outs the controller trusts enough to drop manual review.
FP&A Analyst: budget-against-actual commentary. Learn how variance explanations from the close feed the forecast.
Payroll Specialist: the payroll journal and clearing accounts. Learn the payroll-to-ledger tie-out.
skills_to_grow: Writing match rules and tolerances as testable rules, not Excel habits
Basic SQL or Python to read and change the scheduled jobs on the data platform
Designing control tests: duplicates, segregation of duties, IBAN changes, entries after close
Reviewing model-drafted text and entries critically, checking that every figure can be rebuilt
Process measurement: touch rate, days to close, audit adjustments
role.ambitious_version: A continuous close: tie-outs, bank and agency reconciliations and control tests run every night on AFAS and Rabobank data, so the accountant reviews a short exception list daily and month-end shrinks to adjusting entries and sign-off. The controller gets a reconciliation status the auditor can reuse, which cuts days to close and audit adjustments.

tasks.short: Register, match, code and get approval for supplier and agency invoices, then prepare the payment batch.

steps.what: Pick invoice PDFs from AP mailbox and register them in AFAS
Match invoice to purchase order, receipt or agency hours; code ledger and VAT

loop.input: Agency invoice lines and free-text descriptions without a clean order number
loop.output: Proposed order, worker and week per line, with ledger and VAT code
loop.check: Totals and hours must tie exactly to the agency hours export and order rates; any difference goes to exceptions
loop.stop: One pass per invoice; if the tie fails or confidence is low, route to the accountant
loop.why_not_simpler: Three agencies write lines differently and often omit order references, so fixed rules leave many lines unmatched

steps.what: Chase budget holders by mail for invoice approval
Resolve exceptions: price differences, missing orders, supplier questions
Build payment batch, check duplicates and changed IBANs, release in Rabobank

tasks.design: Configure AFAS invoice scanning and approval workflows so invoices arrive registered and route to budget holders without mail. A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform matches invoices to orders and agency hours, with a bounded model step for messy agency lines, and runs duplicate and IBAN-change tests before the batch. The payment batch is still released in Rabobank by two people.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agency invoices did not tie to orders without reading free text, and approvals lived in mailboxes, so building matching rules for three agency formats was not worth it.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes the matching job and tests cheap to build, and small model steps can read free-text invoice lines reliably enough when an exact tie-out checks them.
tasks.still_hard: Disputes with suppliers and agencies about rates and hours, and invoices from agencies that change formats. Payment errors are hard to reverse.
tasks.human_edge: Deciding whether a price difference is acceptable, knowing which supplier or agency tends to overbill, and the second signature on payments.

ambition.what: Run payment batches twice a week with early-payment discounts taken, instead of one weekly batch.

tasks.altitude: The accountant handles only exceptions and batch release, and owns the match tolerances and approval routes in AFAS.

reach.learn: Which invoice types still need a manual touch and why.
How disputed agency invoices are settled, to feed better match rules.

evidence.claim: Workday's Accounting Agent prepares entries while teams stay responsible for review
Invoice processing can run at autonomy 3 to 4 with tests on every transaction such as duplicates and IBAN changes
B2B e-invoicing in the Netherlands is planned from 1 July 2030 but is not law yet; a PDF is not an e-invoice
AFAS Profit offers invoice scanning and approval workflows

assumptions: Bookkeepers do most AP intake; the accountant handles coding, exceptions and batches.
Agency portals can export hours per order and week.
unknowns: Which AFAS modules and licences Noordhaven has for invoice scanning and workflow.
How many invoices a month, and the share from staffing agencies.
Whether agencies send invoices with order references.
Current dual-control rules for Rabobank payment batches.
research_questions: What share of agency invoice lines tie exactly to portal hours with simple rules?
How many touches per invoice today, measured on one month of AFAS data?
Does AFAS approval workflow cover all budget holders across the three sites?
How many duplicate or changed-IBAN payments were caught or missed in the last year?

tasks.short: Prepare and check monthly records and statements for accuracy, completeness and Dutch GAAP and policy conformance.

steps.what: Export trial balance and subledgers from AFAS into Excel
Tie trial balance to subledgers, bank, payroll journal and intercompany
Review movements against prior month and budget, flag outliers

loop.input: Variances above threshold with underlying transactions and descriptions
loop.output: Draft explanation per variance naming the driving transactions
loop.check: Every amount in the explanation must trace to listed transactions and sum to the variance
loop.stop: One draft per variance; untraceable drafts are dropped and marked 'needs review'
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanations need reading transaction descriptions and writing text; thresholds alone only flag, they do not explain

steps.what: Investigate issues and prepare adjusting entries such as accruals
Write close review memo for the controller

loop.input: Tie-out results, reviewed variance explanations, posted adjustments
loop.check: Figures are pulled from the tie-out data, not generated; accountant edits and signs
loop.stop: Single draft; accountant rewrites if wrong
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template covers figures but not the narrative the controller needs

tasks.design: A nightly job on the governed data platform pulls the AFAS trial balance, subledgers, Rabobank CAMT.053 and the payroll journal and runs fixed tie-outs, shown in a Power BI close dashboard. A bounded model step drafts variance explanations and the close memo with a trace-to-transaction check; adjusting entries stay with the accountant and are approved by the controller.
tasks.previous_blocker: The tie-outs lived in personal Excel workbooks rebuilt every month; scripting them needed developer time Finance did not have.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes scripted tie-outs on AFAS extracts cheap, and models can draft variance text when every figure is checked against the data.
tasks.still_hard: Judgement on accruals, provisions and Dutch GAAP treatment; no benchmark covers Dutch GAAP. Models make multi-step errors and hidden assumptions, so drafts must be traceable.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing the business behind a number, such as a site's seasonal flex peak, and deciding what to adjust and how to explain it to the controller and auditor.

ambition.what: A weekly soft close with tie-outs and variance list, so issues are fixed during the month, not at day 5.

tasks.altitude: The accountant reviews a ready tie-out dashboard and spends time on adjustments; they own the tie-out definitions and thresholds.

reach.learn: Which variance explanations FP&A reuses in the forecast.
What evidence the controller and auditor need to accept a tie-out without rework.

evidence.claim: In a vendor-run study a model beat licensed CPAs on four month-end scenarios, which reward detail and file search, not tacit context
On 160 US GAAP tasks the leading model meets 61.8% of criteria; multi-step reasoning errors dominate
Firms using AI closed 7.5 days faster in a field study
Models that add unnoticed assumptions make workpapers impossible to rebuild

assumptions: Close is done in Excel on AFAS exports today.
A governed data platform or Power BI dataflow can host scheduled jobs.
unknowns: Current days to close and number of manual tie-outs.
Whether intercompany between the three sites runs through separate administrations in AFAS.
Auditor expectations on evidence from scripted tie-outs.
research_questions: Which tie-outs take the most hours today, measured over two closes?
Will the external auditor accept scripted tie-out evidence?
How often do drafted variance explanations need material rewriting in a two-month pilot?

tasks.short: Reconcile bank, agency, payroll clearing and intercompany accounts and clear the differences.

steps.what: Download Rabobank statements and AFAS ledger lines into Excel
Match items: bank, agency invoices to hours, payroll clearing, intercompany
Investigate open items, find documents, ask colleagues by mail

loop.input: Unmatched items with payment references, descriptions and candidate ledger lines
loop.output: Proposed match or cause per item with a reason
loop.check: Proposed matches must net to zero within tolerance; accountant accepts or rejects each
loop.stop: Up to three candidates per item; otherwise left open for the accountant
loop.why_not_simpler: Remaining items have garbled references and split or combined payments that fixed rules miss

steps.what: Post correcting entries in AFAS
Complete and sign the reconciliation workpaper

tasks.design: A daily Python job on the governed data platform reads Rabobank CAMT.053, AFAS ledger lines, agency hours and the payroll journal and applies fixed match rules, leaving a short open item list in a reconciliation app. A bounded model step proposes matches for the leftovers; the accountant approves corrections, which are posted to AFAS, and the workpaper is generated for the controller.
tasks.previous_blocker: Matching rules lived in the accountant's head and Excel; agency and intercompany data had to be pulled by hand from different portals.
tasks.enabler_now: CAMT.053 and AFAS APIs give structured data, and AI coding makes match rules and a small review app quick to build and change.
tasks.still_hard: Differences caused by missing documents or other teams' errors still need people to chase. Agency portal exports may lack APIs.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing who to ask and which differences matter, and deciding when to write off or escalate.

ambition.what: Daily bank and agency reconciliation instead of month-end, so agency overbilling is caught before payment.

tasks.altitude: The accountant clears a short daily exception list and owns the match rules and tolerances.

reach.task: Payroll journal and net pay clearing
reach.learn: Why payroll clearing balances do not net and how to fix the source.
Which customer payment references break matching.

evidence.claim: Cash checks from CAMT.053 suit deterministic software at autonomy 4
Multi-step reasoning across files is where models fail most
Firms using AI closed 7.5 days faster; 62% of surveyed accountants worry about errors

assumptions: Rabobank provides CAMT.053 files to Noordhaven.
The accountant owns bank, agency and intercompany reconciliations.
unknowns: Which agency portals offer exports or APIs.
Number of bank accounts and AFAS administrations.
Average open items per month today.
research_questions: What share of bank lines match with simple rules on three months of data?
Can agency hours be fetched automatically from all three portals?
How many hours per month go into reconciliations, per account type?

tasks.short: Check books and AFAS processes for control weaknesses, policy breaches and wasted effort; propose fixes.

steps.what: Pull journal entries, user rights and master data change logs from AFAS
Test segregation of duties, manual journals, entries after close, bank changes
Sample entries and check against accounting policies and coding rules

loop.input: Manual journal descriptions, amounts, accounts and the SharePoint accounting policy
loop.output: Flag per entry: fits policy, possible breach, unclear, with the policy clause
loop.check: Accountant reviews all flagged entries and a random sample of unflagged ones
loop.stop: One pass per entry; unclear goes to the accountant
loop.why_not_simpler: Policy fit depends on free-text descriptions, such as capitalisation or accrual wording, that fixed rules cannot read

steps.what: Measure process efficiency: touches, rework, close timeline
Write findings and improvements, discuss with the controller

loop.output: Draft finding per issue: what, risk, proposed fix
loop.check: Accountant edits; each finding links to the exceptions it is based on
loop.why_not_simpler: Writing findings needs text; a template only lists exceptions

tasks.design: Scheduled control tests on the governed data platform run over every AFAS journal, user right and vendor change and feed a Power BI controls and process dashboard. A bounded model step flags manual journals that may breach the SharePoint accounting policy and drafts findings; the accountant confirms and discusses fixes with the controller.
tasks.previous_blocker: Testing every transaction needed scripting skills and AFAS log access; sampling by hand was the only option.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes full-population tests cheap, and models can read journal descriptions against written policy with a human checking every flag.
tasks.still_hard: Judging whether a process is effective, and changing how other teams work. Tests on user activity can count as employee monitoring, which needs works council consent and an AVG check.
tasks.human_edge: Judging root causes, weighing control risk against effort, and persuading colleagues to change a process.

ambition.what: A monthly controls report for the Finance Director and auditor covering every transaction, not samples.

tasks.altitude: The accountant moves from sampling to designing and tuning tests, and gains a say in which controls and process changes Finance adopts.

reach.task: AFAS user rights and HRIS access
reach.learn: How joiner and leaver changes reach AFAS rights, to spot segregation gaps.
Which risks the auditor focuses on, to prioritise tests.

evidence.claim: Internal control tests over every transaction (duplicates, segregation of duties, IBAN changes) suit deterministic software, with findings written by a model step
Judgement, not retrieval, is the bottleneck on full accounting tasks
Governance guidance puts estimates and judgement outputs on mandatory human review

assumptions: Accounting policies are written down in SharePoint.
AFAS logs master data changes and user activity accessible via export.
unknowns: Whether AFAS change logs are retained long enough and can be exported.
Whether the works council treats user-activity tests as monitoring under WOR article 27.
Whether there is an internal control framework today.
research_questions: How many segregation-of-duties conflicts show up in a first full run on AFAS rights?
What share of model policy flags does the accountant confirm in a two-month pilot?
Does the works council require consent for tests on named users' postings?
